review_method: Direct reading of all139 complete specs plus source-specific frozen witnesses; explicit authored proposals only.
scope_limits: No model/API/CLI generation, embedding, image or network calls. Local standard-library JSON parsing and read-only code inspection only.
Semantic false-block witnesses and static guard interpretation are not runtime pixel or native-qualification certification.
No quota, tag-count or retrieval-score objective. No batch automatic retagging.

runtime_guard_distinctions.native_qualification: Binds complete role evidence to actual slot spec hash, owned property, source quote, exact RID and effects. It does not itself repeal catalog/binding/source applicability.
runtime_guard_distinctions.subject_categories: Primary generation subject category gate is not the same as existence of a secondary owned hand, garment or instrument.
runtime_guard_distinctions.domains: Topic/purpose domains can coexist; current guard rejects if any denied domain intersects. allow_domains without require_domain_match is not an allow-only list.
runtime_guard_distinctions.allow_domains_override_subject_categorie: Only a matching allowed domain can override category scope; it does not override denied domains, actor existence or effects locks.
runtime_guard_distinctions.required_carriers: An explicitly reviewed empty list is a decision, not inferred default. Nonempty target/carrier pairs require exact active span/baseline-grounded frozen assertions. Carrier existence does not authorize edits or add a live/depicted actor.
runtime_guard_distinctions.control_vs_content: A no_people/age/content/exclusion/control guard is not positive scene evidence. Review metadata, routing tags and non-active context examples do not qualify a content role.
runtime_guard_distinctions.migration: Changing a spec changes spec/catalog hashes. Existing proof must be reopened/revalidated; copying hashes or retaining old binding deny lists does not implement the proposed semantics.

all_slot_assessments.assessment: Concrete activity; no topic/category limit. Separate motion and static articulation.
Explicit selected adult context and adulthood are distinct; no relaxation from ordinary adult presence.
Documentary/craft denies may reject declared aesthetic practice, but no two exact counterexamples established here.
Prior selected event residue is narrower than current damage; category/domain gates need prior-event witnesses, not charred-name shortcuts.
Declared age and presentation remain separate from inferred actual age; preserve intrinsic adult restrictions.
P03/P08 remove unrelated topic denies and clarify distinguishable airborne units.
Part ownership/continuity is independent of pose/form; explicit represented anatomy stays represented.
Aperture/optical path has broad categories and needs identified observing apparatus, not any frame hole.
P09 distinguishes unresolved scene optical field from units and camera-path flare.
P07 addresses documentary/craft denies only; cultural context still must be explicit.
Secondary background owner differs from primary subject and whole-place state.
Explicit contour/volume with represented carrier distinction; no body weight/health/identity inference.
Regional body hair is neither scalp arrangement nor skin texture.
Human-primary/wildlife policy is narrower than a generic owned-body definition; actual animal/representation witnesses needed before change.
Body axes can exist beyond human; do not remove gates without existing-carrier and source-prerequisite examples.
Whole-body support differs from action and axes; human-primary restriction needs owned nonhuman pose witnesses.
Named region does not by itself prove inclusion or visibility.
Natural grooming can occur in documentary/craft; two positive owned-brow witnesses not established here.
Explicit calendar type differs from clock time/occasion; not inferred from scenery.
Observation axis/roll separate from height, distance and actor turn.
Actual separation is not shot scale or focal length.
Height needs a named reference and does not establish angle.
Declared camera stability/movement separate from subject motion and recorded blur.
Acquisition device class is not device visibility, mounting or emulated look.
Camera/operator/support/reflection geometry separate from purpose and device class.
Require-domain allowlist may age poorly for new contexts, but no two frozen out-of-list context witnesses proved here.
Declared bearing/role contrast need not imply private emotion; nonhuman and topic extension lacks exact paired evidence.
Explicit narrative goal is not diagnosed private intent. Do not infer a policy relaxation from generic adult or violence words.
Cosmetic cheek pigment differs from flush; documentary/craft restriction needs exact cosmetic-source examples.
Local owner color differs from whole-image grading and illumination color.
Topic denies conflict in principle with image-level grading; no complete second graded-product/wildlife witness assembled here.
Primary human limitation may exclude animal-animal accompaniment; primary/companion count and exact species must remain explicit.
Cosmetic opacity differs from skin state. Topic relaxation needs genuine cosmetic-layer witnesses.
Within-frame arrangement differs from crop obligation and platform safe area.
Food/wildlife/adult denies are not a conceptual definition; separate policy rationale and owned contrast witnesses before change.
P01 accepts explicit nonhuman contact/support without creating actors or endpoints.
Group occupancy is not automatically human; topic/adult policy and count locks require separately bounded review.
Explicit personal background is contextual, not an appearance inference; do not generalize to object provenance.
Sharp-depth extent differs from chosen focus plane and absolute detail.
Local fixture wear/use trace differs from entire place state and explicit prior-event aftermath.
Recorded clipping/tone is not incident light intensity.
Human/animal scope is meaningful; represented actor carrier needs explicit treatment rather than assuming all objects emote.
